assets.license: Public domain in the US: published in the US in 1876 (all US works published before 1931 are PD). The PDF is a straight scan of the 2-D page, which adds no new copyright under US law (Bridgeman v. Corel). The PDF carries an NYT logo and a 'Copyright The New York Times' footer: both are cropped out; TimesMachine's own terms of service were not reviewed.

assets.what_it_shows: 'FLESH DESCENDING IN A SHOWER. An astounding phenomenon in Kentucky - fresh meat like mutton or venison falling from a clear sky.' Full dispatch incl. Allen Crouch, Olympian Springs, two gentlemen who tasted it.
